decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [DEW/2026/01/32W/S1 (R2), DEW/2026/01/32W/S2(R2),, DEW/2026/01/32W/03(R2),  DEW/2026/01/32W/04(R2), DEW/2026/01/32W/05(R2),  DEW/2026/01/32W/06(R2), DEW/2026/01/32W/07(R2),  DEW/2026/01/32W/08(R2),  DEW/2026/01/32W/09(R2),  DEW/2026/01/32W/10(R2),  Planning statement, Design and Access Statement, Flood risk assessment, Daylight Sunlight and Overshadowing Assessment, Biodiversity checklist, Fire safety statement, application form- Received 16/04/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The proposed windows within both side elevations shall be obscure glazed, notably those serving bedroom 01 and the kitchen as per dwg no. DEW/2026/01/32W/07(Rev 2), and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted. No additional doors shall be formed within the front elevation of the development.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy.

Condition : 6 - The extension hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose ancillary to the enjoyment of the house at the 'Site Address' described at the top of this decision letter and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes.
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.
description: Proposed Single Storey Rear & Side Extension
